[size=5]FAQ[/size]
"Can I use these portraits in my modpack?"
Of course! Just make sure to link back here if anyone asks where you got them from, or credit me in some way!

"Why did you do this?"
I felt like it.

"Can I use these portraits in video/streaming content I make online?"
Yep, same rule as before--I just want credit for what I made!

"What order are you making these in?/How do you decide which portrait to work on next?"
I use Wheel of Names. You can add weight to the chances for certain characters using channel points in my Twitch streams, if you want.

"What program are you using to paint these?"
Rebelle 7.

"Why are you taking so long?"
I'm burnt out.
